description: A custom visual pie chart divides data into colored slices, each representing a category with size proportional to its share of the whole. Features include category labels, dynamic colors, interactive tooltips, and optional legends and animations. Users can click slices for filtering, making it ideal for visually exploring parts-to-whole relationships. Key features Width-: Modify the width to change the overall size and proportions of the Pie chart. Rotation-: Rotate the chart to change the viewing angle, making specific slices more prominent. DataLables-: Our visual offers flexible data labeling options, allowing you to toggle visibility, adjust font size and color, and fine-tune numeric formatting (e.g., units and precision). Perfect for delivering precise insights at a glance. Legends and tooltips-: Enable a legend to label slices and apply custom styles. Tooltips display additional details when hovering over slices. Interactive filtering-: Click on any slice to filter your dataset in real time, making it easier to analyze individual segments. Slice color setting-: This feature enables users to personalize the color scheme of the chart slices, Users can assign specific colors to each data category, improving the visual distinction between slices.
